Application Data.NAME: Green Thumb Landscaping Services
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Green Thumb Landscaping Services specializes in providing full-service garden and landscaping solutions, including design, installation, and maintenance of residential and commercial outdoor spaces. Our operations involve sourcing plant materials exclusively from licensed nurseries that comply with all local agricultural regulations. We also offer seasonal services such as lawn care, tree trimming, and garden clean-up, ensuring adherence to best practices for environmental sustainability. Furthermore, we utilize equipment and vehicles that are regularly maintained and operated by our trained staff, minimizing risks associated with property damage or liability.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On June 12, 2022, a minor equipment failure resulted in a tree trimming accident causing property damage to a neighboring fence. The estimated cost to repair the damages was $3,500. The claim was filed and settled promptly, with the status marked as "Closed." Additionally, on September 5, 2021, a worker slipped on wet grass during maintenance activities, leading to a claim for $1,500 for medical expenses. This incident was also resolved with the claim status marked as "Closed." Total losses incurred amount to $5,000.
Application Data.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: UL Listed Commercial Safe, Class B, Grade I, Model S-2000
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Privacy fencing around work sites and a security camera monitoring system.
